latestVersion.changelog:
Kiss Video Maker Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly create romantic kiss-themed videos from user-uploaded photos or clips, with automated music and transitions.
- No editing skills required—just upload files and describe your desired result.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG uploads (up to 200MB each); outputs ready-to-share 1080p MP4.
- Runs entirely server-side with secure, token-based sessions and up to 100 free credits for new users.
- Includes quick actions: export video, check status/credits, upload or manage timeline, all through simple chat prompts.
- Designed for couples, TikTok, and social media users who want fast, cinematic romantic video creation.
